cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sys, io
sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
import zstandard as zstd
data=b'A'*100000
c=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True, level=3)
f=c.compress(data)
print('len',len(f))
bad=bytearray(f); bad[20]^=0xff   # corrupt inside compressed block
try:
    r=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(bytes(bad)), read_across_frames=True).read()
    print('corrupt content ->', len(r))
except Exception as e: print('corrupt content err', type(e).__name__, e)
# dict id frame
try:
    d=zstd.ZstdCompressionDict(b'some dictionary content here'*10)
    cd=zstd.ZstdCompressor(dict_data=d)
    fd=cd.compress(data)
    p=zstd.get_frame_parameters(fd)
    print('dictid',p.dict_id, 'window',p.window_size)
    try:
        r=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(fd), read_across_frames=True).read()
        print('dict frame read ->', len(r))
    except Exception as e: print('dict frame err', type(e).__name__, e)
except Exception as e:
    print('dict create err', type(e).__name__, e)
# big window
cb=zstd.ZstdCompressor(window_log=28)
fb=cb.compress(data)
print('window28 params', zstd.get_frame_parameters(fb).window_size)
"
